	We are seeking an experienced Logistics Specialist to manage and streamline our supply chain, customs clearance, freight forwarding, and material dispatch operations.

	Oversee warehouse inventory movement, loading/unloading operations, and inland transport fleet routing.

	Monitor logistics costs, audit freight invoices, and implement cost-saving measures across the supply chain.

	Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel and logistics software/ERP systems for inventory tracking and report generation.
	Attributes: Strong negotiation abilities, detail-oriented mindset, and excellent problem-solving skills under tight deadlines.

Logistics Specialist Job at BGE (Nigeria) Solar FZE




        
    

        
        BGE (Nigeria) Solar FZE is a leading enterprise in the new energy photovoltaic cell industry, committed to driving sustainable development and innovation. As we expand our global footprint, we are seeking exceptional local talent in Nigeria to join our dynamic team.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Logistics Specialist

Job Location: Ogun

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Logistics Specialist to manage and streamline our supply chain, customs clearance, freight forwarding, and material dispatch operations.
	This role is crucial in ensuring the smooth import of manufacturing equipment and raw materials, as well as the efficient distribution of finished products.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate end-to-end import/export logistics, including shipping schedules, freight tracking, and port clearance procedures.
	Manage relationships with clearing agents, shipping lines, freight forwarders, and regulatory bodies (Customs, NEPZA, Standards Organization, etc.).
	Prepare, inspect, and verify all essential logistics documentation (Form M, Bills of Lading, Packing Lists, Commercial Invoices, Certificates of Origin).
	Oversee warehouse inventory movement, loading/unloading operations, and inland transport fleet routing.
	Track shipment delivery timelines and resolve delays, custom holds, or transit issues proactively.
	Monitor logistics costs, audit freight invoices, and implement cost-saving measures across the supply chain.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Education: Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Regulatory Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Nigerian customs procedures, port clearance regulations, and Free Zone operational guidelines.
	Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel and logistics software/ERP systems for inventory tracking and report generation.
	Attributes: Strong negotiation abilities, detail-oriented mindset, and excellent problem-solving skills under tight deadlines.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVto: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Front Desk Officer Job at Emel Hospitals Limited




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

Emel Hospitals Limited Festac Town, Lagos, Nigeria isa multi-specialists’ hospital, situated at 21 Road, Z Close in Festac Town, Amuwo Odofin Local Government Lagos, Nigeria. Emel Hospital is a purpose-built 44 bed hospital situated on a piece of land specially approved for its purpose by the Federal Housing Authority.

Emel Hospital was established in 1988 by Dr. Olufemi Mobolaji-Lawal, a consultant paediatrician. Dr. Mobolaji-Lawal trained as a doctor at the University College Hospital, Ibadan and as a paediatrician in the United Kingdom. Prior to setting Emel Hospital, he worked for some time as consultant paediatrician at Ikeja General Hospital (now Lagos State University Teaching Hospital), Lagos. He is the board chairman and his wife, Dr. (Mrs) Margaret Mobolaji-Lawal is a non-executive director.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Front Desk Officer

Job Location: Festac Town, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Patient Reception & Registration:


	Welcome patients, visitors, and clients politely and professionally.
	Register new patients and update existing patient records accurately.
	Verify patient information and documentation.
	Direct patients to the appropriate departments or units.


Appointment Management:


	Schedule, confirm, and reschedule patient appointments.
	Manage daily appointment logs and clinic schedules.
	Inform patients of delays, cancellations, or changes when necessary.


Communication & Customer Service:


	Answer phone calls, emails, and walk-in inquiries promptly.
	Provide accurate information about hospital services, visiting hours, and procedures.
	Handle patient complaints calmly and escalate issues when necessary.
	Maintain professional communication with patients, staff, and management.
	Maintain proper filing and documentation of patient records.


Billing & Payment Support:


	Assist patients with billing inquiries and payment directions.
	Issue receipts or direct patients to the appropriate payment points.
	Coordinate with accounts or HMO desk where necessary.


Confidentiality & Compliance:


	Maintain confidentiality of patient information at all times.
	Adhere to hospital policies, procedures, and ethical standards.
	Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Minimum of HND/Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Mass Communication, or related field.
	Previous experience in customer service or hospital reception is an advantage.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and hospital management software.
	Good telephone etiquette and interpersonal skills.

Executive Assistant Job at TalentForge Solutions Limited




        
    

        
        TalentForge Solutions Limited - Our client in the Technology industry is recruiting qualified and results-driven candidates to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Executive Assistant

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

About the Role


	We are looking for a proactive, organized, and discreet Executive Assistant to support senior leader
	You’ll be the right hand for managing schedules, ommunications, and operations to ensure everything runs smoothly.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage executive calendar, schedule meetings, book travel, and handle logistics
	Draft emails, memos, reports, and correspondence on behalf of leadership
	Prepare documents, presentations, and meeting minutes. Maintain files and records
	Coordinate between departments, clients, and external stakeholders
	Handle confidential information, track action items, and follow up to ensure deadlines are met
	Anticipate needs, troubleshoot issues, and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.


Requirements


	HND / BSc in Business Administration, Office Management, or related field
	3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or in a similar administrative role
	Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and calendar management tools
	High level of discretion, professionalism, and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 monthly. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Executive Assistant" as the subject of the email. 

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Video Content Creator Job at Odixcity Consulting




        
    

        
        Odixcity Consulting is an International HR consulting and procurement firm. With expertise in Recruitment & Selection, Performance management, Training & Development, Compensation and benefits as well as Outsourcing of goods and services for organizations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
 Job Position: Video Content Creator

Job Location: Remote
Employment Type: Part-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for creative individuals to capture and record daily activities. No prior experience is needed- just your smartphone and your time.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Ability to record daily activities as instructed (simple, non-technical content) like washing, Ironing e.t.c.
	Ensure videos are clear, stable, and well-lit using your phone.


Requirements


	Must use an iPhone 12 or higher version, Google Pixel, and Samsung Galaxy S21 ONLY.
	Self-starter who can work with minimal supervision.
	Ability to dedicate 1 or more hours daily.
	Your Environment must be well-lit.


Renumeration


	$3 per hour.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: For more enquiries, contact 08103264136.
